title: calamintha graveolens subsp. purpurascens
intro: Calamintha graveolens subsp. purpurascens, commonly known as Purple Calaminta or Mountain Mint, is a subspecies of the Calamintha graveolens plant, a member of the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is a low-growing, fragrant herb native to Europe, known for its potential health benefits, including aiding digestion and relieving nausea. The therapeutic actions of Purple Calaminta include its ability to act as a carminative and antispasmodic, helping to reduce flatulence and alleviate muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils such as borneol, camphor, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
